cinacalcet.note: Calcipar 30 mg film-coated tablet (Ind-Swift Limited, India; imported and distributed by DeGa International Pharma Corp.) is registered as DR-XY43911 (Alu/Clear PVC/PVDC blister of 10s, box of 30), issued 25 March 2022 with an expiry date of 24 November 2024 on the FDA Philippines portal; a renewal was not found, so it is not listed under Products.
